note: A centred 6 by 6 by 2 slab (z -1..1) fused with a hexagon of circumradius 1 at (1, 0) extruded 2 to each side (z -2..2): the prism sticks out 1 above and 1 below, inside the slab's footprint. V = 72 + 2 (3 sqrt3 / 2); A = 120 + 12 (the slab, the hexagon's two caps replacing the patches they cover, and 6 * 1 of sides on each side); centroid x = 2A_hex / V; 20 planar faces (6 + 7 + 7).
